passages.scripture: This is a trustworthy saying: If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.

lines.text: Paul says this saying is trustworthy — people can rely on this saying.
“If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.”
An overseer is a leader who watches over and cares for a church.
To aspire to be an overseer is to reach for that work and long for it.
Being an overseer is a noble task — good and honorable work.
